landing.does.title: Made for food trucks, not restaurants.
landing.does.lede: Most ordering systems assume you have one fixed address, reliable wifi and the same hours every week. You are somewhere new every week, at different times, with weak or no network at all. HatchGrab was made for that situation.
landing.does.capacityBody: Set how much you can cook at one time, and how long it takes. When a collection time fills up, customers can’t choose it.
landing.does.devicesBody: It works on the phone in your apron pocket, the tablet on the counter, the laptop in the van — and the card machine you already use to take payment.
landing.does.postsTitle: Make your Facebook and Instagram posts automatic
landing.does.postsBody: Upload the design you already post on Facebook or Instagram. We will fill in your dates, places and times, ready to share — every week or every day.
landing.does.whatsappBody: “Where are you tonight?” “What desserts do you have?” Your WhatsApp gets answered while you are driving to your trading spot or at the grill, using your own menu and schedule. Messenger and Instagram are coming soon.
landing.does.whatsappSoonBody: “Where are you tonight?” “What desserts do you have?” Soon your WhatsApp will be answered while you are driving to your trading spot or at the grill. Messenger and Instagram will follow.
landing.does.offlineBody: If you lose network, online orders are paused automatically so customers don’t place orders you won’t see. Keep taking orders with the iPhone, iPad and Android app.
landing.does.slotsBody: Customers order ahead and choose a collection time. Fewer queues, and the food is ready when they arrive.
landing.steps.title: Get ready and start taking orders in about 15 minutes.
landing.steps.lede: Three things to complete — and two of them need only a photo.
landing.steps.menuBody: Take a photo of your menu board or paste it in. Items, prices and extras all come in by themselves. You just check that they are correct.
landing.steps.scheduleBody: Is it on your website? We will read it from there and keep it updated all the time. If not, take a photo of it too. You just approve what is found.
landing.steps.shareBody: Post it on Facebook, stick the QR code on the van. Orders come in on your screen, in the order you need to cook them.
landing.testimonial.quote: HatchGrab has made taking orders much easier. Everything is organised, we can track stock and know exactly how many pizzas are left to sell — and the time slots are very good for busy villages.
landing.testimonial.award: Best Mobile Pizzeria of the Year
landing.pricing.title: Start free. Upgrade your plan when you need to.
landing.pricing.switchBody: See how much you would pay on HatchGrab for the same orders. It takes about one minute.

landing.final.title: Would you like to see how easy it is to get started?
landing.final.lede: Upload a photo or a screenshot of your menu and we will turn it into a working ordering page for you to try in under 60 seconds. Your items, your prices. No signing up, no card, nothing to install. Have a look, then decide.

featuresPage.detail.walkup_orders: Take and manage orders at the food truck, paid on your own card machine.
featuresPage.detail.kitchen_app: The fullest way to run HatchGrab: a live kitchen screen (KDS), plus the only way to keep taking orders when you lose network.
featuresPage.detail.multi_device_kitchen: Use several screens — front counter and kitchen — all showing the same orders in real time.
featuresPage.detail.multi_user_access: Give staff their own ways to log in, with the right level of access.
featuresPage.detail.offline_protection: If you lose network, online orders are paused so customers don’t place orders you won’t see. The iPhone, iPad and Android app lets you keep taking orders without network; the web dashboard needs a connection.
featuresPage.detail.ticket_printing: Print order tickets on a Bluetooth or wired printer in the kitchen.
featuresPage.detail.web_dashboard: Run your service from the browser of any phone, tablet or laptop.
featuresPage.detail.meal_deals_upsells: Combine items into meal deals (combo) and offer extras at checkout to raise the average order value.
featuresPage.detail.sold_out_toggle: Mark any item as sold out with one tap — it fades out for customers straight away.
featuresPage.detail.stock_countdown: Set a stock count and it will go down as orders come in, then sell out by itself.
featuresPage.detail.buzzer_tracking: Give an order a buzzer number when you hand out a buzzer, so you know which buzzer belongs to which order.
featuresPage.detail.documents_reminders: Keep your certificates in one place, such as food hygiene, insurance and gas safety. We remind you before anything expires, and you can send them to an event or market organiser with one tap.
featuresPage.detail.profit_per_event: Add what each dish costs you and see the real profit you made at every event, not just the takings.
featuresPage.detail.accountant_reports: Sales, tax and refunds for any month, quarter or tax year, ready to download for your accountant.
featuresPage.detail.tap_to_pay: Take card payments on a supported phone, so you don’t need a separate card machine.
featuresPage.detail.customer_display: A screen customers can see, showing order numbers and when they are ready.
featuresPage.detail.online_payments: Take card payment up front when customers order online, via Stripe.
featuresPage.detail.advance_preordering: Let customers order for a future date or time before the event.
featuresPage.detail.preorder_deadline: Set a deadline for items that need notice in advance.
featuresPage.detail.time_slot_selection: Customers choose a collection time slot, so demand is spread across the whole of your service.
featuresPage.detail.kitchen_capacity: Set how much your kitchen can cook at one time and how long it takes. When a time slot fills up, customers can’t choose it.
featuresPage.detail.auto_accept: Online orders are accepted automatically — no need to confirm each one.
featuresPage.detail.private_events: Add private events that don’t appear on the map, with their own private ordering link and QR code.
featuresPage.detail.embed_schedule: Show your upcoming dates on your own website. Each one leads straight to its order page.
featuresPage.detail.qr_code: A printable QR code that opens your menu and ordering page.
featuresPage.detail.branded_qr_code: Put your logo on your QR code.
featuresPage.detail.discovery_map_listin: Your food truck appears on the public HatchGrab map so nearby customers find you.
featuresPage.detail.schedule_import: We fill your schedule automatically — from your website, or a picture you already post on Facebook. You just review and confirm.
featuresPage.detail.event_types: Create your own event types, with custom prices and settings for events and festivals.
featuresPage.detail.social_media_posts: Upload your designs — we add your dates, places and times for every week and every event automatically.
featuresPage.detail.whatsapp_auto_replie: WhatsApp auto-replies to questions about your menu and schedule.
featuresPage.detail.messenger_instagram_: The same as WhatsApp auto-replies, for Messenger and Instagram questions.
featuresPage.detail.sms_order_alerts: Send customers an SMS automatically when their order is ready.
featuresPage.detail.loyalty_stamp_cards: Reward returning customers with digital stamp cards — collected and redeemed automatically.

aboutPage.meta.title: About us — HatchGrab
aboutPage.meta.description: HatchGrab makes software for food trucks and catering: online orders, collection times and fewer repeated questions. Founder: Dominic Bonini.
aboutPage.title: Built around how food trucks really work
aboutPage.story.start: HatchGrab started with one simple thing I noticed: food trucks need better tools to run their businesses.
aboutPage.story.villageFoodie: After starting Village Foodie, a directory that helps people discover food trucks visiting their areas, I spent more time learning about the challenges that mobile food businesses face. Unlike ordinary restaurants, food trucks move all the time, working in different places and serving customers in changing conditions.
aboutPage.story.fixedAddress: Yet most of the software available to them is designed for businesses with one fixed address.
aboutPage.story.change: HatchGrab was created to change that.
aboutPage.story.build: We make practical software specifically for food trucks and mobile catering services, helping them take orders online, manage collection times, make sure orders flow without problems and spend less time answering repeated questions.
aboutPage.story.focus: Our aim is simple: to make running a food truck easier, with tools designed around how these businesses really work.
